address: Hauptplatz 7, Bad Sankt Leonhard im Lavanttal, 9462, Austria
bio: From the Alps to the Adriatic is the motto of the Trippolt family restaurant. Dishes such as pasta mare – In & Out scampi ravioli in a crab stock will transport you to Mediterranean climes, while the delicately roasted juniper venison with fluffy raspberry ricotta-filled dumplings, honey lavender and elderflower jelly highlights their ties to the region, as well as chef Josef Trippolt's passion for hunting. In addition to a set menu and a well-devised à la carte selection, daily specials are featured on the blackboard. The refined, lovingly designed interior of this restaurant steeped in tradition is a pure delight, as is the lovely little garden terrace.
